component: Per-layer eager dispatch on the shared Qwen3.8-27B / Qwen3.6-35B-A3B trunk

sources.head: 063d77b561fc1b61ccce5b0395dc549d1b86bbe0
sources.used: Idea only, read from the PR description: chunked mx.async_eval every N layers on decode-sized eager verify forwards so the GPU starts while the host builds later layers; bit-identical by construction. No code read or copied.
Same mechanism already shipped for Flash-Next (provenance/eager-dispatch-2026-09-20.json): stride/max-rows shape, round_levers counter names.

modifications: Qwen3_5TextModel (shared by qwen38_27b and qwen36_35b) gains eager_dispatch_stride/eager_dispatch_max_rows, set only through set_eager_dispatch; 0 = off.

Adapters accept execution-policy keys eager_dispatch_stride (int) and eager_dispatch_max_rows (int, default 64) over a per-adapter default_eager_dispatch_stride (0 on the 27B; 2 on the 35B from 2026-10-01); no model-name branch in shared code.

A selected stride is recorded in adapter.environment as MLX2_EAGER_DISPATCH_STRIDE/MAX_ROWS (route identity, present only when on) and makes feature_eager_dispatch a required observed-use qualification check; diagnostics expose eager_dispatch and round_levers.
Unlike MTPLX, the last layer also submits (as Flash-Next does); pipeline-parallel forwards never submit.
validation: GPU (M5 Max): greedy B1/B4 tokens and final logits bitwise equal at strides 2 and 4 on Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-4bit and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MLX-4bit-uniform; engine token streams identical across strides on both oQ4e-mtp artifacts (native MTP B1, ordinary B1/B4).

Engine: 27B neutral (MTP B1 1.001x, ordinary B1 0.996x, B4 0.995x); 35B ordinary B4 1.070x (every round 1.061-1.080), MTP B1 1.039x then 1.029x on a 6-round confirmation with 4/6 rounds ahead (pre-registered bar not met).
qualification: implemented; 27B opt-in; 35B selected by default (stride 2, max_rows 64) on Pierre's decision 2026-10-01; unqualified until the 35B route is requalified with feature_eager_dispatch observed-use evidence
